baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural subject of kafaru is followed by fi plus the indefinite verbal noun takdhib, locating the people inside an activity or condition rather than merely attaching a single claim to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth-covering supplies the agents' act, while attributing falsehood supplies the content of takdhib. The preposition turns repeated counter-assertion into their surrounding social and epistemic medium.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth supplies the literal posture of the subject and functions as entry into the denial-medium.
Declaring a person or report false supplies the content of takdhib and functions as the practice named after fi.

changed_reading.before: They disbelieve and make a false judgment about the message.
changed_reading.after: Their truth-covering has become an enclosing, collective practice of counter-declaration in which they remain situated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Takdhib is a process noun after fi, and its root inventory includes a charge that proves true only by being carried through.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause can stage denial as an unfinished campaign rather than a completed verdict: its participants are committed inside a charge whose own truth or failure will be disclosed by performance.

activation_trace.role: Rejection of truth identifies what the campaign is trying to maintain.
A charge that succeeds or fails by being carried through supplies a performative test and makes takdhib an exposed undertaking.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib names a settled conclusion that the message is false.
changed_reading.after: Takdhib names an ongoing falsification campaign whose own claim remains under practical test and can fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent roots permit a material linkage between covering and a patterned surface that deceives by its condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kafaru supplies an overlay; the cloth branch of k-dh-b supplies an appearance that misreports what it covers. Fi then places the group inside a manufactured surface-world rather than only inside spoken falsehood.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the overlay that hides an underlying state.
A dyed or patterned cloth that deceives by appearance supplies the false surface and makes denial materially self-presenting.

changed_reading.before: Their denial is an inward opinion or an outward statement.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is also a fabricated overlay whose visible condition misrepresents what lies beneath it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context turns the deceptive overlay into defensive architecture. Yet a non-dominant split branch contributes a visible sign of condition, so the fortification that should conceal also marks and displays its occupants' state.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the defensive skin of the model.
The deceptive patterned surface supplies a visible facade that can misreport its interior.
A visible mark from the non-dominant mapped root makes the attempted concealment diagnostically legible to an observer.
Fortified towers supply the defensive enclosure and turn the denial-overlay into an inhabited stronghold.

structural_cues: The surah opens with an elevated expanse characterized by buruj before presenting any human actors.
The focus preposition fi already gives the denial a spatial interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: covering, a deceptive surface, a visible diagnostic mark, and fortifications. Reader arrow: the marked fortress becomes an analogy for concealment that advertises the condition it defends. Live alternative: the opening may remain cosmic scene-setting with no diagnostic relation to 85:19.

changed_reading.before: The denial-overlay hides its occupants behind a convincing facade.
changed_reading.after: Denial behaves like a fortress-like facade whose very visibility marks the condition it tries to hide.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed appointment and the repeated witness vocabulary place the focus counter-declaration inside an evidentiary session. The deniers do not stand outside the case and reject it; their rejection is already an event within a witnessed and temporally bounded record.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the adverse declaration being entered into the evidentiary frame.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the bounded session in which the declaration will be exposed.
Presence together with seeing supplies both an observer and an observed event, making denial recordable.
Knowledge-bearing disclosure expands the witness frame beyond local human observation.

structural_cues: The appointed day is immediately followed by the active/passive pair witness and witnessed.
Witness language recurs for the actors in 85:7 and for God in 85:9 before the focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a fixed appointment, witnessed presence, informed disclosure, and a declaration of falsehood. Reader arrow: their declaration is treated as countertestimony already inside the record it contests. Live alternative: the witness sequence may solemnize the scene without establishing a procedural or juridical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They make an abstract skeptical judgment from outside the claim.
changed_reading.after: They enter adverse testimony inside an appointed, multiply witnessed event that also records their act of rejection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stationed monitoring, deliberate action, and punishment for assured assent turn takdhib into an enforced social order. Because the same actors watch what they do, their performance generates testimony against the counter-reality they are trying to maintain.

activation_trace.role: Truth-covering supplies the aim of suppressing acknowledgment.
Falsehood in speech or action allows takdhib to be carried by conduct rather than speech alone.
Sitting in ambush or observation supplies the stable monitoring position from which the regime is maintained.
Bringing an act about supplies the concrete performance of denial upon other people.
Presence with seeing makes the perpetrators observers of their own enacted counterclaim.
Assent in which the heart finds rest supplies the targeted alternative to their coercive instability.
Punishment following disapproval turns rejection into a sanctioning mechanism.

structural_cues: The repeated subject pronoun in 85:6-7 links sitting, doing, and witnessing as one sustained posture.
The exceptive construction in 85:8 makes the victims' assent the sole stated object of resentment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: monitoring, action, self-presence, secure assent, and punitive disapproval. Reader arrow: these actions are treated as the social machinery of takdhib, while self-observation turns that machinery into counterevidence. Live alternative: witnessing may indicate presence without the stronger self-indicting force.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a belief or repeated verbal rejection.
changed_reading.after: Denial is an organized, coercive practice that disciplines assent and paradoxically makes its agents witnesses to the conduct sustaining it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The campaign branch of k-dh-b meets a root that tests metal or people and a sequence of burning. The coercive falsification campaign can therefore be carried as an assay whose procedure produces observable results and risks falsifying the testers' own verdict.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true only by being carried through supplies the campaign placed under test.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism and makes the coercive act evidentiary.
Burning and blackening supply the material means by which the attempted test is conducted.
Flame supplies the returning material consequence and closes the assay around its operators.

structural_cues: Fire with fuel appears in 85:5, while 85:10 joins the testing verb to punishment by burning.
The same plural-agent construction later reappears in the focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a campaign that can fail, an assay of metal or people, burning, and flame. Reader arrow: the persecution is treated as an experiment whose result can bear against the experimenters' falsehood verdict. Live alternative: fitna may denote persecution and trial without any metallurgical feedback mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The deniers direct a claim of falsity at the message and its adherents.
changed_reading.after: Their falsification becomes a material assay that generates counterevidence and can reverse judgment onto those conducting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beginning and returning prevent the denial-campaign from closing the case. Reports arrive and renew as speech about mutually supporting collectives, so takdhib becomes a repeatedly reopened undertaking rather than a verdict that can make its object disappear.

activation_trace.role: The charge whose validity depends on completion supplies the campaign that seeks closure.
Beginning explicitly paired with return supplies the opening pole of a repeatable cycle.
Return after departure supplies recurrence that reopens what denial treats as settled.
Arrival supplies the directional entry of evidence into the hearer's present.
Speech renewed as report supplies narrative evidence that becomes present again in each telling.
A mutually supporting collective supplies organized historical actors whose reports pressure the collective denial.

structural_cues: The paired verbs of 85:13 place initiation and repetition in one clause.
The interrogative of 85:17 makes the arrival of a report an event for the addressee immediately before 85:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: beginning, return, arrival, renewed report, and organized collectives. Reader arrow: these are treated as recurring evidentiary pressure that denies the denial-campaign final closure. Live alternative: cosmic renewal and remembered reports may remain separate assurances rather than mechanisms acting on takdhib.

changed_reading.after: Takdhib is a campaign repeatedly reopened by returned action and newly arriving reports, so it cannot stabilize its verdict as final.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context introduces a second kind of covering: one that protects a person by effacing a wrong's effect, paired with love. This distinguishes covering by object and direction. Kafaru covers truth away from acknowledgment; ghafur covers fault away from destructive consequence.

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the suppressive use of concealment.
The same focus root's expiatory branch shows that covering can also efface liability, keeping a restorative counterpossibility live.
A cover that guards what it covers supplies the protective geometry opposed to suppression.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies restorative concealment directed at consequence rather than truth.
Love supplies the relational orientation that separates protective covering from hostile truth-covering.

structural_cues: The failure to repent in 85:10 is followed by beginning and return in 85:13 and then the paired attributes forgiving and loving.
The focus root inventory itself contains both hostile truth-covering and expiatory covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: suppressive truth-covering, expiatory covering, protective forgiveness, and love. Reader arrow: the shared material gesture is polarized by what is covered and for whose benefit. Live alternative: gh-f-r may function as a divine attribute without intentionally contrasting the material semantics of k-f-r.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns covering as though concealment itself were the whole problem.
changed_reading.after: The focus condemns a hostile direction of covering: truth is suppressed, whereas the context keeps open a loving cover that removes fault's destructive effect.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places the deniers inside takdhib; the next ayah places an encompassing presence around and behind them. Their denial-shell is therefore not an outside refuge but an inner container that is itself fully contained, known, and unable to hide a reverse side.

activation_trace.role: Concrete concealment supplies the inner shell the deniers attempt to inhabit.
The active declaration of falsehood supplies the contents and maintenance of that inner shell.
Hiding a thing behind appearance supplies the imagined reverse side where concealment might seek refuge.
Physical surrounding supplies the outer enclosure around both the people and their denial-shell.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession removes any epistemic outside from the spatial model.

structural_cues: The pronoun in 85:20 directly resumes the plural group of 85:19.
The sequence moves without interruption from fi takdhib to from behind them encompassing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an inner covering, adverse declaration, a hidden reverse side, and total physical and epistemic enclosure. Reader arrow: adjacency and pronoun continuity nest the denial-container inside the encompassing one. Live alternative: 85:20 may assert oversight independently without making takdhib an inner spatial shell.

changed_reading.before: Being in denial gives the group a self-contained refuge from the claim.
changed_reading.after: Their denial is only an inner shell inside a larger enclosure; even its concealed reverse side remains surrounded and known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated bal and fi constructions set two containers against one another. The deniers inhabit an active counter-declaration, while the gathered recitation is located in a full, written, guarded record. Takdhib becomes a rival social archive that can contest but cannot alter the preserved source-record.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report false supplies the rival counter-record made by the deniers.
Gathering and collection supply the coherence of the recited material that denial tries to fragment or dismiss.
Fullness to sufficiency supplies plenitude and resists the deficit implied by the counter-declaration.
A broad board used for writing supplies the durable record-container parallel to fi takdhib.
Guarding and watchful care supply persistence against alteration by the rival record.

structural_cues: Bal opens both 85:19 and 85:21, first relocating the deniers and then reidentifying what they deny.
Fi introduces takdhib in 85:19 and the guarded board in 85:22, creating a formal container-to-container echo.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: adverse declaration, gathered plenitude, a writing board, guarding, and the repeated bal/fi syntax. Reader arrow: the two prepositional constructions are read as rival archival containers, with preservation blocking the counter-record from changing its object. Live alternative: the repeated particles may be local discourse and location markers without a deliberate archival parallel.

changed_reading.before: Takdhib is a negative opinion directed at a recitation.
changed_reading.after: Takdhib is a rival container and counter-record set against a gathered, sufficient recitation secured in a guarded inscription it cannot rewrite.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cultivator branch is form-distant from kafaru. It remains anchored in the focus root and is materially activated by the concealed garden, flowing water, and earth-cutting river of 85:11. Downstream prose should present it only as an agricultural contrast, not as a lexical translation of kafaru.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root k-f-r includes covering seed, while the clause's fi construction can hold a material environment of unsuccessful covering.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies the buried potential whose outcome distinguishes sterile suppression from cultivation.
A garden concealed by trees supplies a life-bearing form of cover opposed to truth-burial.
Continuous flowing supplies the generative movement absent from the denial enclosure.
A river cutting earth with running water supplies emergence through covered ground rather than permanent burial beneath it.

changed_reading.before: Kafaru denotes only rejection or concealment of truth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, their denial buries potential without generative flow, unlike the life-bearing concealment of a watered garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a fragile but valid split-root activation: the source surface in 85:16 ordinarily carries volition, while the non-dominant mapped branch contributes rejection of counterfeit or error. It remains anchored because takdhib itself issues a falsehood verdict and the context assigns effective agency elsewhere. Render it as a possible reversal of adjudication, never as a gloss of yuridu.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Takdhib attributes falsity to a report; the outlier asks whether that adverse verdict can itself be treated as the rejected counterfeit.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood supplies the verdict whose authority is being reversed.
Effective action supplies the agency able to carry a reversal beyond mere counter-speech.
The non-dominant split branch's rejection of counterfeit or error returns the deniers' own falsity judgment upon itself.

changed_reading.before: The deniers occupy the role of judges who reject the message as false.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their judgment is itself the counterfeit verdict rejected under an agency capable of effecting what it wills.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wild-animal idiom is branch-distant from the form takdhib and is therefore surprising. It remains anchored in k-dh-b and gains exact sequential support from behind them and encompassing in 85:20. Downstream prose should use an explicit kinetic simile, not translate takdhib as flight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The k-dh-b inventory includes running a stage, stopping, and looking behind; fi takdhib can momentarily be imaged as occupying that interrupted motion.

activation_trace.role: Running, stopping, and looking behind supplies the denial's interrupted escape-motion.
A rear side that can also denote front or elsewhere supplies the backward glance while destabilizing any privileged exit direction.
Physical surrounding closes the kinetic image by placing every attempted direction inside an enclosure.

changed_reading.before: They remain statically lodged in denial.
changed_reading.after: As a contained simile, denial is an interrupted flight that stops to look behind only to find every direction already encompassed.

strongest_changes: Fi takdhib shifts from a mere opinion to an enclosing collective practice and coercive social order.
Witness, appointment, and self-observation turn denial into adverse testimony that generates its own counterevidence.
The next ayah nests the denial-shell inside a complete physical and epistemic enclosure.
The repeated bal and fi constructions oppose a rival counter-record to a gathered recitation in a guarded written container.
Material assay, recurrence, and opposed kinds of covering keep performative, temporal, and restorative readings alive beside the spatial one.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause activated several coexisting mechanisms rather than one paraphrase: enclosure, campaign, false surface, testimony, coercive performance, assay, recurrence, and archive. The most productive contextual movement came from reversals: concealment becomes visible, perpetrators witness themselves, a test bears against its operators, a denial-container is itself contained, and hostile covering is contrasted with protective covering.
remaining_uncertainties: The degree to which fi should retain literal spatial force rather than idiomatically mark a state remains open.
The fortress, seed, halted-flight, and non-dominant split-root readings are analogical activations, not lexical substitutions.
The witness sequence may be juridical, perceptual, solemnizing, or several of these at once.
The rival-archive reading depends on treating the repeated bal and fi constructions as a deliberate formal echo rather than local syntax only.
